settings.subtitle: Customize Studio appearance, language, theme palette, and runtime connection.
settings.appearanceHint: Choose your Studio theme and light or dark mode. Both settings apply immediately and persist across launches.
settings.paletteTransDescription: Flag sky-blue, pastel pink & white over a calm deep-navy or ice shell.
settings.paletteObsidianDescription: Electric violet & teal accents over a carbon or alabaster shell.
settings.followingSystem: Following the operating system: {mode, select, light {light} other {dark}} right now.
settings.systemFollows: System follows the operating system’s light or dark setting.
settings.themeSummarySystem: {palette} · {mode, select, light {Light mode} other {Dark mode}} (following the system)
settings.languageHintWeb: The choice applies immediately and is saved in this browser.
settings.languageHintDesktop: The choice applies immediately and is saved on this computer.
settings.cjkFontMissing: No Chinese font was found on this system, so Chinese text may appear as boxes. Install a CJK font such as Noto Sans CJK.
settings.connectionHint: The AgentFlow runtime admin API this Studio window is connected to.
settings.transportNoteLocal: A browser cannot open a socket or pipe, so Studio’s local proxy on this origin does and forwards each request.
settings.transportNoteProxy: Requests go to Studio’s local proxy on this origin, which forwards them to the runtime. No CORS entry is needed.
settings.transportNoteDirect: The browser calls the runtime itself, so the runtime must allow this origin (below).
settings.tokenNoteStored: Remembered in this browser’s localStorage, in plain text. Anyone who can use this browser profile can read it. Lock forgets it.
settings.tokenNoteTab: Kept for this tab only (sessionStorage, in plain text). A reload stays signed in; closing the tab forgets it.
settings.tokenNoteNone: Not saved in this browser: it is held in memory, and a reload asks for it again.
settings.forgetMessageActive: Forget {name}? Its address and token are removed from this browser and you return to the welcome screen.
settings.forgetMessage: Forget {name}? Its address and token are removed from this browser.
settings.allowedOriginNote: A direct connection works only while the runtime lists this page’s origin under {key}. Keep this in its config (a change applies at the next restart):
settings.lockTitle: Forget the token and return to the welcome screen
settings.lockNote: Lock forgets the token and returns to the welcome screen; the address stays saved.
settings.switchNeedsToken: Opens the welcome screen to enter its token
settings.shortcutsHint: Navigate workspaces and trigger common editor actions from the keyboard.
settings.shortcutSaveWeb: Save: apply changes in Builder, validate and save in Config
settings.shortcutDocsBack: Open docs / return to previous view
settings.shortcutsBrowserNote: A browser keeps Ctrl+N, Ctrl+1…9 and F5 for a new window, switching tabs and reloading the page, so Studio uses {alt}+N for a new agent, {alt}+1…9 for the views and {alt}+R to refresh, in the browser and the desktop app alike.
settings.preludeHint: The Lua-facing API version of the connected runtime. Every loop declares the one it targets ({marker}) and the runtime refuses any other.
settings.updatesSubtitle: Keep the desktop application up to date from GitHub Releases.
settings.updateConfirmMessage: Download AgentFlow Studio {version}, verify its SHA-256 checksum, replace this installation and restart?
settings.updateReasonReadonly: Installed in a read-only location ({platform}). Upgrade via your package manager or download from GitHub Releases.
settings.updateReasonMissingAsset: No auto-update package is published for {platform}/{arch} on this release.
